name: Aqua Danchecker
original_name: アクア・ダンチェッカー
source:
Aqua is one of the more dominating supporting character. She is both the vice-president of intelligence club and the vice-president of the military club. That plus her constant involvement around [url=/c1047]Lidia[/url] makes her seem like a main heroine. Unfortunately, it is not so. Her ability is the coolest one in the game. Her katana can slice through time and space, allowing Aqua to essentially move at insane speeds and dodge anything coming her way. As well as instant teleport to slice through opponents make her the ideal swordsman.

[Edited from [url=http://whatistomato.wordpress.com/2010/07/09/a-tribute-to-evolution/]Warum's review[/url].]
